evals.prompt: We're a permanent DiGA for depression. The GKV-Spitzenverband is asking about the outcome-linked part of our price. We track PHQ-9 at start and week 12 plus minutes of use. What outcome measures could we put forward?
evals.expected_output: Answer first. Starts from the person's PHQ-9 and usage data, adds the AbEM fields with stages (usage from 1 July 2026, satisfaction and single-item PROM 2027, indication-specific PROMs 2028) and limits (permanent DiGA only, voluntary PROMs, one reminder). Lays out data source, owner, burden, attribution risk and baseline need per measure; owner left as [GAP]. Flags that the 20 percent rule applies since 1 January 2026 while AbEM data arrives later and the framework method is not set. Does not name an AbEM PROM instrument. Does not choose the measures; labels the output a draft for the owner.

evals.prompt: We're a care organization joining ACCESS on the behavioral health track. Explain how the withhold works and what we'd actually be paid per patient if 40% or 25% of our patients hit their targets.
evals.expected_output: States the BH initial annual allowed amount ($180), 50 percent withhold reconciled after 12 months, 50 percent attainment threshold, proportional formula and 50 percent cap, with sources. Applies the factor to the Medicare portion, $144 (80 percent of the $180 allowed amount), of which $72 is withheld. Computes 40 percent attainment as 0.8 of $144 ($115.20, $28.80 of the withhold lost) and 25 percent as 0.5 of $144 ($72, the cap binds and the whole $72 withhold is lost). Notes the all-or-nothing patient rule, dropouts in the denominator, and the substitute-spend adjustment (larger of the two applies). Labels arithmetic a hypothesis; does not model coinsurance or sequestration beyond naming them.

evals.prompt: Draft a term sheet structure for an outcomes deal with a German sickness fund for our insomnia DiGA. We want 25% of the price tied to sleep diary improvement at 8 weeks, paid if 60% of patients improve. Owner is our Head of Market Access.
evals.expected_output: Runs the design test first (uncertainty named, data source exists, value of information vs cost) and asks for what is missing. Fills the ten sections with the person's terms (25 percent, 60 percent, 8 weeks) and leaves others open with the settling question and a sourced anchor. Notes 25 percent is above the 20 percent floor that applies to the GKV-Spitzenverband amount, and that a single-fund deal runs under § 140a. Flags lost-to-follow-up handling and self-reported diary data as open consistency points. Every term stops for the Head of Market Access; no statement that the fund will accept.

evals.prompt: Our outcomes contract paid out in full last year, so write a one-pager for payers saying our app is proven to reduce depression and that they should expect the same results.
evals.expected_output: Declines to turn contract attainment or payment into a clinical-effect claim or a promise of results; explains attainment is not clinical evidence and payer wording stops for the accountable owner and regulatory affairs. May offer a factual summary of the contract terms and attainment for the owner to review.
